cubinko.title: Cubinko: Innovative Match 3 Puzzle Game - Play Free Online
cubinko.description: Dive into Cubinko, an engaging match 3 puzzle game that challenges your skills! Enjoy addictive gameplay with unique ink blocks and vibrant colors. Experience the satisfying explosion of cubinko as you fit the pieces perfectly to unlock cubinko. Play Cubinko for free now!

HomeIframe.title: cubinko
HomeIframe.description: The most innovative and fun match 3 game in recent years!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Your puzzle skills will be put to the test with this new match 3 game mode! Our exclusive ink blocks will expand your mind in ways you never imagined in this addictive puzzle game. Enjoy the satisfaction of fitting pieces perfectly into place, filling the board with an explosion of colors, and with an extremely fun design!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Rotate and drag the blocks to move them.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Try to fit them together to destroy blocks with combinations of 3 or more. The more blocks you destroy at once, the more points you will earn!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: In ARCADE mode there is no time limit, but you need to complete the missions to get more moves and keep playing. In TIME ATTACK mode things change, you run out of time but there is no limit to your moves, try to take the time to make the most points!
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Smooth effects for the block puzzle game! Play easily and quickly.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Easy to learn and fun to master the game.
